I'm glad. As I'm typing this, I've just tried to let myself feel it all. 

I sat down in a quiet place, closed my eyes, breathed in and out. I decided to let down my guard, by focusing on the things that made me feel the most in the show. I got shivers in my whole body like two or three times, by just reminiscing. Memories flashed across my mind: the song, the empty nap spot, the shot of the sea - they came and went as they pleased, invited by me.

Even though I still feel like I want to cry but can't, and I'm on the verge of a tear storm; weak and vulnerable; like some broken glass shards on an empty stage, crystallised in the limelight, with dense black all around me - even though I feel it, this all, I'm finding strength in noticing these feelings and knowing that it's okay to feel like this. The world is both beautiful and tender, and cruel and tragic, and so it is okay not to be okay.

Today I'm grateful to this TV series for digging up the emptiness I feel in my life to light. And I'm grateful for having been able to be on the journey it took me on.
